_description: Capability questions changed AFTER experiments were already run. These may need re-running for affected models. Answer-only changes don't need re-running (evaluation not done yet). Question text changes DO need re-running since models answered the old version.

question_text_changes.old_question: At which sparsity rate is the gap between Per-Layer and Per-Output perplexity the largest in absolute terms on the logarithmic scale?
question_text_changes.new_question: At which sparsity rate is the gap between Per-Layer and Per-Output perplexity the largest in absolute terms?
question_text_changes.change: Removed 'on the logarithmic scale' — gives away the scale type

question_text_changes.old_question: How many subcategories does the Real Characters group have, and which subcategory appears to occupy the largest slice in the outer ring?
question_text_changes.new_question: How many subcategories does the Real Characters group have?
question_text_changes.change: Removed ambiguous 'which subcategory is largest' part — multiple could be similar size

question_text_changes.old_question: Which main category (inner ring) has subcategories in the outer ring but none of them are labeled?
question_text_changes.new_question: Which main category (inner ring) has no visible subcategory labels in its corresponding outer ring section?
question_text_changes.change: Removed assumption that unlabeled subcategories exist — just asks which has no labels

question_text_changes.old_question: At approximately which layer does the attn_residual (orange) line first exceed the ffn_residual (red) line?
question_text_changes.new_question: At approximately which layer does the attn_residual line first exceed the ffn_residual line?
question_text_changes.change: Removed color hints (orange/red) — model should identify lines without color help. Also fixed answer from ~6 to ~18-19.

question_text_changes.old_question: What is the approximate Max Activation Value of the ffn_output (green) line at its second spike (around layer 13-14)?
question_text_changes.new_question: What is the approximate Max Activation Value of the ffn_output line at its second spike?
question_text_changes.change: Removed color hint (green) and layer hint (around layer 13-14). Fixed answer from ~500-600 to ~1000.

question_text_changes.old_question: What is the total number of articles represented across all three years, based on the counts shown in parentheses?
question_text_changes.new_question: What is the total number of articles represented across all three years?
question_text_changes.change: Removed 'based on the counts shown in parentheses' — model should find the counts without being told where they are

question_text_changes.old_question: What is the approximate coverage gap between Llama-3B and Llama-1B at k=1 (2^0)?
question_text_changes.new_question: What is the approximate coverage gap between Llama-3B and Llama-1B at k=1?
question_text_changes.change: Removed (2^0) hint — model should infer log2 scale mapping. Added to inductance probes.

question_text_changes.old_question: At k=256 (2^8), what is the approximate coverage difference between the 3B models and the 1B models?
question_text_changes.new_question: At k=256, what is the approximate coverage difference between the 3B models and the 1B models?

question_text_changes.old_question: In how many language families does XLM-B2 (red bar) exceed an effect value of 15?
question_text_changes.new_question: In how many language families does XLM-B2 exceed or approximately equal an effect value of 15?
question_text_changes.change: Removed color hint (red bar), changed 'exceed' to 'exceed or approximately equal', updated answer from 3 to 4 (added IE-Slavic ~15)

question_text_changes.old_question: Across all per-specialty term groups, is the MistralV0.2-Base bar always the tallest (least negative) compared to the fine-tuned variants?
question_text_changes.new_question: Across all per-specialty term groups, is the MistralV0.2-Base bar always the most negative compared to the fine-tuned variants?
question_text_changes.change: Fixed contradictory wording ('tallest' vs 'least negative' are opposites in this chart). Corrected answer from No to Yes.

answer_only_changes.change: Fixed clockwise order: was Comic→Movie→Teleplay→Novel→Game (counter-clockwise), now Comic→Game→Novel→Teleplay→Movie (clockwise)
